test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which state has the least poverty according to the Multidimensional Poverty Index(MPI) 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The global Multidimensional Poverty Index 2021** compares acute multidimensional poverty for** 109 countries in developing regions**.
 
• These countries are home to 5.9 billion people, three-quarters of the world's population. Of these people, 1.3 billion (21.7%) are identified by the 2021 global MPI as multidimensionally poor.
 
• **Kerala has emerged as the state with the lowest poverty across India, according to Niti Aayog's-multidimensional-poverty.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
